transcript: Hi, I'm Zidan, based in Cairo, Egypt, and I specialize in lead generation, cold calling, lead management, and appointment setting. I have over three years of experience working in U.S. real estate cold calling and lead generation, along with around one year of direct lead manager experience working with U.S. clients and investors. I've also worked in the solar market, which has helped me adapt to different audiences, sales approaches, and business goals. But what I bring to a business goes beyond making calls or following a script. My focus is on turning conversations into qualified opportunities, building trust with prospects, and helping businesses make better use of the leads they generate.

When it comes to cold calling, I understand that every conversation is different. I know how to build rapport, communicate naturally, ask the right questions, handle objections professionally, and keep conversations moving without making prospects feel pressured. I focus on understanding the person on the other end of the call, identifying their needs, and recognizing when there's a genuine opportunity worth pursuing.

In real estate, I understand how important it is to uncover a seller's real motivation. I can qualify homeowners by asking about their reason for selling, property condition, occupancy, timeline, and price expectations. I also understand that some opportunities require consistent follow-up rather than a single conversation, so I focus on maintaining communication and keeping promising leads engaged.

As a lead manager, I look beyond the initial conversation. I focus on lead qualification, follow-up, pipeline organization, and making sure important information is documented accurately. My goal is to keep opportunities moving, prevent qualified leads from being overlooked, and provide the acquisitions team with clear, useful information so they can decide on the next step. I also have experience with appointment setting, coordinating next steps, and supporting the sales process from initial contact through qualification and handoff. I understand the importance of respecting a client's process, following the right criteria, and keeping the team informed.

I'm also comfortable working with the systems behind the process. I've worked with tools and platforms such as GoHighLevel, ReadyMode, CallTools, REI Sift, Mojo Dialer, Enzo, and other CRM and lead management systems. I understand that these tools are only as useful as the way they're managed. That's why I pay attention to accurate records, organized pipelines, consistent follow-ups, and clear next actions. I can also adapt to new tools and workflows when a business has its own systems in place.

Beyond the technical side, I bring strong communication, consistency, accountability, and a willingness to learn. I'm comfortable working remotely, following established processes, managing my responsibilities, and communicating with clients and team members. I take feedback seriously, work toward agreed targets, and focus on improving the quality of my work over time.
I've worked toward performance targets, been recognized as a top achiever, and learned how important consistency and attention to detail are in a results-driven environment.

Whether you need someone to generate leads, speak with homeowners, qualify opportunities, book appointments, manage follow-ups, organize your pipeline, or support your day-to-day sales operations, I can help connect those moving parts and keep the process organized.

My goal isn't just to complete tasks. It's to become someone your business can rely on. Someone who communicates clearly, takes ownership, protects the quality of your leads, and helps your team spend more time on the opportunities that matter.

If you're looking for a reliable professional who understands both the conversations and the process behind lead generation and lead management, I'd be glad to learn about your business, understand your goals, and discuss how I can contribute to your team.
Thank you for taking the time to get to know me. I look forward to working with you.
